country_code.title: country_code
country_code.description:
The ISO country code specifying which country the account is held with. For example, if we receive a request for Germany, then the county code is 'DE', for France, the country code is 'FR'. The list of allowed country codes are:
'DE' - Germany
'FR' - France
'GB' - Great Britain
'IE' - Ireland
'NL' - Netherlands
'US' - United States
'CA' - Canada
'HK' - Hong Kong
'SG' - Singapore
'AU' - Australia
'NZ' - New Zealand
'LU' - Luxembourg
'VN' - Vietnam
'BR' - Brazil
'JP' - Japan

payerid_number.title: payerid_number
payerid_number.description: Unique number assigned for payers and beneficiaries to identify incoming payments. Please provide either the `payerid_number` or the `assignee_id`.

assignee_id.title: assignee_id
assignee_id.description: Assignee ID expected from client for upfront sanction screening and activation of Payer ID number. Please provide either payerid_number or assignee_id.

name_1.title: name_1
name_1.description: LastName Or CompanyName for 'sole trader', include the last name for 'company', include the company name.

name_2.title: name_2
name_2.description: For 'sole trader', include the first name for 'company', leave blank or include second line of company name.

date.title: date
date.description: Sole trader's date of birth or a company's date of incorporation. This parameter is in fixed 10-digit format (YYYY-MM-DD) as per ISO format.

tax_identifier.title: tax_identifier
tax_identifier.description: Merchant tax identifier based on the merchant's country.

Merchant-Economic-Id.title: Merchant-Economic-Id
Merchant-Economic-Id.description: Merchant economic id based on the merchant's country.

Party-Type-Details.title: Party-Type-Details
Party-Type-Details.description:
Account party type details. Allowed account part type values are:

`S` - sole trader, which is an enterprise owned or run by a single person.
`C` - a company that is owned by an organization or business entity
